description.value: Sixth Avenue Sports is a full-service bicycle shop in Hope, BC — the gateway community to the Coquihalla and Fraser Canyon corridors. The shop offers bicycle sales, accessories, and repairs alongside skate sharpening and hockey gear, reflecting Hope's year-round outdoor culture. For touring cyclists arriving in Hope, it is the primary dedicated bike shop in town.
